---
title: "Model intercomparison"
---

```{python}
from _lib import *
est = read("estimates")
ic = read("intercompare")
```

How do different RTMs (and different error models) estimate the "same" quantity? Examples:

* chlorophyll from the PROSPECT versions, LeafSIP and LIBERTY
* water (EWT) from all models
* dry matter (LMA): Cm, Cprot + Ccbc in PROSPECT-PRO, and Cm in LeafSIP

```{python}
#| fig-cap: "Posterior medians of the same trait from each RTM vs PROSPECT-D, fresh leaves, Hetero + OU error model. Log axes; gray line = 1:1. One panel per trait."
if len(est):
    e = est[(est["errmodel"] == "ou") & ~est["rt"].astype(bool) & (est["data_use"] == "all") & ~est["relative"]]
    ref = e[e["model"] == "prospectd"][["observation_id", "trait", "q50"]].rename(columns={"q50": "ref"})
    j = e[e["model"] != "prospectd"].merge(ref, on=["observation_id", "trait"])
    traits = [t for t in TRAIT if t in set(j["trait"])]
    if traits:
        from plotly.subplots import make_subplots
        nc = min(3, len(traits)); nr = int(np.ceil(len(traits) / nc))
        fig = make_subplots(rows=nr, cols=nc, subplot_titles=[trait_label(t) for t in traits],
                            horizontal_spacing=0.08, vertical_spacing=0.14)
        for i, t in enumerate(traits):
            r, c = i // nc + 1, i % nc + 1
            g = j[j["trait"] == t]
            lo, hi = np.nanquantile(np.r_[g["ref"], g["q50"]], [0.005, 0.995])
            one_to_one(fig, lo, hi, r, c)
            for m in MODELS:
                h = g[g["model"] == m]
                if h.empty:
                    continue
                fig.add_trace(go.Scattergl(x=h["ref"], y=h["q50"], mode="markers", name=MODEL_LABEL[m],
                                           legendgroup=m, showlegend=(i == 0),
                                           marker=dict(color=MODEL_COLOR[m], size=7, symbol=MODEL_SYMBOL[m],
                                                       line=dict(color=SURFACE, width=1)),
                                           customdata=h["observation_id"],
                                           hovertemplate="%{customdata}<br>PROSPECT-D %{x:.3g}<br>" + MODEL_LABEL[m] + " %{y:.3g}<extra></extra>"),
                              r, c)
            log_axis(fig, "x", [lo, hi], r, c, "PROSPECT-D")
            log_axis(fig, "y", [lo, hi], r, c, "other RTM")
        fig.update_layout(height=330 * nr + 60, margin=dict(t=110),
                          legend=dict(orientation="h", y=1.0, yanchor="bottom", yref="container"))
        show(fig)
else:
    no_data()
```
